from urllib.parse import parse_qsl, urlsplit
from links import with_query

params = {'first key': 'a b', '한글&=': '雪 & =', 'last': 'x=y&z'}
encoded = 'first+key=a+b&%ED%95%9C%EA%B8%80%26%3D=%E9%9B%AA+%26+%3D&last=x%3Dy%26z'
assert with_query('https://example.test/path', params) == 'https://example.test/path?' + encoded

    ('/path?old=a%20b&raw=x=y#frag?x#tail', '/path?old=a%20b&raw=x=y&' + encoded + '#frag?x#tail'),
